name: CALCULAR CUSTO
BUSCAR ULTIMAS LEITURAS
func:
msg.topic = `
SELECT
    (SELECT energy_kwh
     FROM telemetria
     WHERE data_hora >= date('now','-3 hours') AND data_hora < date('now','-3 hours','+1 day')
     ORDER BY data_hora ASC
     LIMIT 1) AS energia_inicial,

    (SELECT energy_kwh
     FROM telemetria
     WHERE data_hora >= date('now','-3 hours') AND data_hora < date('now','-3 hours','+1 day')
     ORDER BY data_hora DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS energia_final
`;

return msg;
